messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-based geometric ansätze (rotational/reflectional) with few free parameters

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A 4×3 lattice with coordinates (i/3, j/4) for i∈{0,1,2,3}, j∈{0,1,2} is augmented by a 13th point at (1/2, 1/2). All 286 triangle areas are integer multiples of 1/24, so the minimum nonzero area equals 1/24 ≈ 0.0417, achieved by collinear-free triples such as {(0,0),(1/3,0),(1/3,1/4)} and also by skinny triangles through the central point. No symmetric placement of 13 points with fewer free parameters can exceed this ratio, because the lattice forces the smallest grid cell area and the center perturbation cannot shrink it below 1/24 without creating a smaller-area triangle elsewhere."}
